highlights:
## 🧩 Claude keeps going with every tool

Some connected MCP servers describe their tools in an older format. Once one of those tools loaded, Claude refused every later message in that chat. Nod now tidies each tool description before sending it, so the chat keeps working.

## ⏱️ Useful results during long tasks

Ask for something big, like “Find every invoice I haven't paid this quarter.” When Nod has a checked finding that helps you act, it shares it and keeps working. Later related findings arrive together instead of one message each.

## 💸 Long chats cost less

Long conversations reuse your model provider's prompt cache again. On OpenAI models, long chats cost less than on 0.8.2.

## Also in this release

- **Updates:** **Restart to update** restarts right away, without asking a second time.
- **Sign in with ChatGPT (Windows):** Works again when Windows keeps an expired copy of a certificate.
- **Apps:** Connecting works again when your computer's clock is a few seconds off.
- **Browser:** The workspace browser opens again after Nod restarted while it was running.
- **Email:** Reading many emails at once no longer hides their content.
- **WhatsApp:** With a separate bot number, Nod answers messages that WhatsApp sends from a private ID.
- **Models without a price:** **Settings → Notifications** explains why automatic preparation doesn't run.
- **Self-hosted:** Long workspace commands no longer stop after 30 seconds.
